title: MACHINE GUNS SOUND LIKE MACHINES
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sound generally and give every action that has no distinct noise one of its own. Every machine fired the pillager rifle sound, so a sentry across the street sounded exactly like a man with a rifle, or like your own gun. Now each machine fires its own: the sentry a fast electric snap with a servo tick, the warden a deep cannon thump with a metal slap, the Overseer the same an octave down and louder, the bulwark a dull plated bark and the pillbox a hollow turret pop. The pillbox also played a second rifle crack on top of every round; that is gone. The new sounds come from one small table of short recipes, so the noises still to come are cheap to add and each keeps its own gap so a big fight never smears.
now: Each machine now fires its own sound, so you can tell a sentry from a pillager by ear.
